svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How anatomiya works
svg.desc: Two columns. What a scan does: collect the corpus from git ls-files, find the areas, parse once in a pool of child processes with oxc, prism and tree-sitter, count each dimension per area with one pass over git log, apply the gates at 0.90 of sites with a Wilson bound and a pinned baseline, and write the map into .claude/rules and .claude/anatomiya. What the hooks do in a session: refresh rescans in the background when HEAD moves, echo hands the overview back, notice speaks before a Write or an Edit, reuse asks one subagent for an existing function when the turn ends, and /anatomiya:check compares the branch with its merge base before review.
svg.text: What a scan does
Collect the corpus
the files git ls-files lists, nothing else, less fixture,
vendor and build directories
Find the areas
any directory holding enough source; the smallest fold
into their parent when there are too many
Parse once, in a pool of children
oxc for JavaScript and TypeScript, prism for Ruby, seven
tree-sitter grammars shipped as WebAssembly for the rest
Count per area
each dimension: sites that conform out of sites that could,
plus one pass over git log for authors and what ships together
Apply the gates
at least 0.90 of sites, a Wilson lower bound, enough files
and authors, and the pinned baseline; the rest print as counts
Write the map
